title: GEMglDisable
description: enable or disable server-side GL capabilities

messages.description: symbolic constant indicating a GL capability

arguments.description: symbolic constant indicating a GL capability

body: [GEMglDisable] calls glDisable() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glEnable in the OpenGL reference.
